# The Cosy Place

> Private self-catering cottage in Marlborough, Harare, Zimbabwe.

- Website: https://thecosyplace.co.zw/
- Location: Marlborough, Harare (near Westgate, Avondale, Strathaven, Avonlea)
- Stay options: whole cottage (2 bedrooms, up to 4 guests) or one bedroom (up to 2 guests); cottage is never shared
- Rates (USD): whole cottage $70/night (2–10 nights) or $65 (11+ nights); one bedroom $50 or $45 for the same lengths
- Amenities: full kitchen, uncapped Wi-Fi, DSTV, solar inverter, solar geyser, borehole water, washer/dryer, parking for 2 cars
- Booking: direct via https://thecosyplace.co.zw/#booking ; whole cottage also on Airbnb
- Contact: +27 64 666 2761 · WhatsApp · tinashejsibanda@gmail.com

- [Home](https://thecosyplace.co.zw/): cottage overview, rates, booking
